scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @shridhar/server && npm run build --workspace @shridhar/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run fieldtest && npm run i18ntest && npm run rastertest && npm run printertest && npm run schematest && npm run selftest
scripts.apk: npm run build:shared && npm run apk --workspace @shridhar/mobile
scripts.mobile: npm run build:shared && npm run start --workspace @shridhar/mobile
